scope: Exact registered-source requirement; preserve pure metadata and all existing checker policy.

complete_hunk_reviews.decision: Import the pure finite-registration predicate. The existing metadata dispatcher and candidate-source helper remain byte-identical. This module only identifies registered subjects or borrowed markers; it never reads files, executes the compiler or grants source/behavior credit.

Include registered source decisions in the existing contract/sensitive classification. That makes the existing needsIndividual path validate their complete individual proof and account for a failure, including final do-not-adopt labels. Merely adding needsIndividual without a failure bucket would not reject admission. Every existing condition, allowed-final set and failure counter remains intact. The actual CLI source-fault control and its deliberately weakened-checker counterexample exercise this exact addition.
